name: Giant Wasp
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A golden-and-dark striped wasp with a narrow waist, transparent veined wings, hooked feet, and a pointed stinger.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual for the 2024 rules, released in 2025, p. 361. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195032-giant-wasp
